text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Today is Christmas—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A party was being held,
inviting Maruzensky's juniors.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san! Thank you so much
for throwing such a wonderful party for us!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I wonder if they're enjoying themselves?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Of course! It wasn't just fun, the food was absolutely amazing too~!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan, you're eating way too much without holding back, YES!
Training tomorrow is going to be rough, you know, YES~?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! About one minute after the party started, 
I had already braced myself!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure what's "fine" about this, though...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, holding back
would just be a waste.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "Don't worry about what comes next! The best thing is to enjoy ourselves to the fullest and eat delicious food!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yes, you're right.
Holding back would be downright rude.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Come on, King, eat up, eat up.
Then we can cry on the scale tomorrow together, okay?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Sky-san, are you trying to have fun with me
instead of enjoying the party?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, it's such a lively
and fun Christmas♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky-san, thank you so much for today~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You're very welcome~♪
Seeing everyone so happy makes me happy too!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer-kun?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer-chan?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Rewinding back a few days—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer-kun.
You even carried my bags for me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer-chan.
You even carried my bags for me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Preparations for the juniors' Christmas party
are now totally hunky-dory!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I can't wait to see the look of delight on everyone's faces~!
choice_data_list: You always look out for your juniors, huh.
You always look out for your juniors, don't you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Because they're all so cute!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"It makes me want to watch over them like a senior,
or rather, just seeing them look so full of energy makes me happy..."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You know how the saying goes, right?
'Boys will be boys, as long as they grow up strong!'

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? But my mom
says it all the time...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, I'm going to bring joy to everyone who worked so hard this year!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: And so, I'm counting on your continued cooperation!
choice_data_list: Let's make it a fun party!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yes! Time to catch the fever~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, getting to have fun with everyone like this
makes me so happy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san and Trainer-san,
you two are like our Santa Clauses!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, that's right~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has been such good girls that
I just couldn't resist giving you all presents♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Come on, come on, enjoy the party to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes! All right, time to dig in!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"That was so much fun~♪
Thanks for your help, Trainer-kun!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"That was so much fun~♪
Thanks for your help, Trainer-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Well, now that I've handed out presents to all the good kids, Santa's gonna dash on home♪
choice_data_list: Are you sure you don't want a present?
Don't you want to receive a present?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"As long as it makes everyone happy,
that's more than enough for me!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I don't really look like the type
to jump for joy over getting a present, do I?"
choice_data_list: Still, they've been such a good kid, it makes you want to get them a present.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...!?
Trainer-kun, for me?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...!?
Trainer-chan, for me?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, so you're
my Santa Claus, huh?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, so that means you're
my Santa Claus, huh?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It'd be rude to hold back, so maybe I'll just take you up on your kind offer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what would be good... How about
joining me for a drive right now?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And so, the delightful Christmas continued on for a little longer."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Speaking of which, Maruzen-san,
aren't you a good girl yourself?!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Because you put together
a party just for us..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I want to give you a present too,
Maruzen-san! What would you like!?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"You really don't need to worry about that.
I mean, I'm the big sister now, after all..."
choice_data_list: Don't be shy, just take it.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Geez, not you too, Trainer-kun...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Geez, not you too, Trainer-chan...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, I know!
How about I make myself the present!?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: My present to Maruzen-san is that I'll keep running as your opponent from now on!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Then, just like Spe-chan, I will
become a partner who runs with you forever♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: "I can't have you having all the fun while leaving me behind, desu!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-senpai, I'm going to prove
I can be your rival too!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "Of course, this King will gladly take up the challenge!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Huh, is that the kind of mood we're in?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But who knows, maybe right now I could actually put up a surprisingly good fight...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Special Week's lead, the other juniors
raise their hands to take on Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, so all of you are
my Santa Claus, huh?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'll gladly accept the gift!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So everyone, try to overtake me
and pass me by!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Christmas party
came to a close on a high note.
